facts.fact: ILRAJ asks Parliament to keep the safeguards of Sierra Leone's Right to Access Information Act of 2013, which it says scores 126 of 150 on the Global Right to Information Rating, including independent review of rejected requests and appeal to the High Court.

ILRAJ sent Parliament's Legislative Committee 22 amendments to the Data Protection and Right to Access Information Bill, 2026, which would also cover access to information and which it says could weaken the 2013 Act.
facts.system: Data Protection and Right to Access Information Bill, 2026

SLE.note: Document mentions national ID numbers only as personal data to protect; no authentication service stated.
Nothing on a civil register to ID link.
The Data Protection Authority is only proposed in a bill; no law names it and no appointment is stated.

facts.fact: The Data Protection and Right to Access Information Bill, 2026 is before Parliament's Legislative Committee, which ILRAJ addressed with 22 amendments on 2026-11-17.
